answer: Each agent presents a hardware TEE quote bound to a key it cannot export, and the quote is revoked the moment the recruit misbehaves, so one chip cannot back a thousand accounts. Three peers from unrelated subnetworks countersign before the identity counts. Faking a trellis of agents means buying a device per seat, and a thousand machines each die on first abuse. No pigment on a dashboard hides that bill; growth slows to the rate real hardware is bought, and a glacier of clones never forms.
